name: mcp-tiime
description: Drive your Tiime account from Claude: invoices, bank transactions, receipts, expense reports, VAT and your accounting firm.
long_description:
Community MCP server for [Tiime](https://www.tiime.fr), with 92 tools: invoices and quotes, bank transactions and receipt matching, expense reports and mileage allowances, categories and rules, VAT estimate and exchanges with the accounting firm.

Two-factor authentication is supported: when Tiime asks for a code, Claude calls `start_login`, reads the code you received (for instance with the Gmail connector) and calls `complete_login`. Your password stays in the extension settings and never goes through the conversation.

**Unofficial**: this project is not affiliated with Tiime. It uses the internal API of the Tiime web application, which may change without notice.

email.title: Tiime email
email.description: Email address of your Tiime account.

password.title: Tiime password
password.description: Stored by Claude Desktop in your system keychain. Used to log in again when the session expires.

company_id.description: Default company. Leave 0 to detect it, which works when the account has a single company.
